facts.text: Deborah mentioned a park near her house that has a forest trail and a beach, where she can do yoga and reflect.

evidence.quote: I love going to this park near my house - it has a nice forest trail and a beach. It's a peaceful spot where I can do some yoga and reflect.

facts.text: Deborah described a special bench at the park that holds special meaning to her, which is associated with memories of her and her mother.

evidence.quote: There's also a special bench that holds special meaning to me.
It holds a lot of special memories for me and my mom - we would come here and chat about dreams and life.
